subject: jr-dym
title: JR.DYM.------POL.P.
description: Chart on book p. 171 (EVOL-9). JR-DYM (journalism dynamics) is the subject; POL-P (political policies) is the partner. From the subject: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics), SOC-RT (social reality) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From EXP-DY: EXP-CONT-1 (expansion condition (composite focus)). From EXP-CONT-1: INFO-FM (information forum). From SOC-RT: CN-INFO (controlled information). From CN-INFO: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INTR: RE-DOC (redocumentation). From SPT-DY: C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude). From C-CULT-AT: C-INFO (composite information) and AF-NT (affinity nature). From C-INFO: H-PR. From AF-NT: INFO-TRNS (information transference), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
